idea-plugin.name: MarkdownUp
idea-plugin.description:
Convert between Markdown and Jira Wiki Markup straight from the right-click menu.

  • Convert File — converts the file and swaps its extension.
  • Generate New File — keeps the original and writes the converted file next to it.
  • Convert Selection / Document — works on the selected text or on the whole editor content.

Supports headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, code blocks, links, images, nested lists, tables, quotes and horizontal rules, in both directions. Works offline, with no extra tools to install.

Files: Markdown .md / .markdown, Jira .jira / .jiramarkup.

Source code: github.com/rafaelwms/markdownup
idea-plugin.change-notes:

  • Converter now runs natively in the IDE; Node.js is no longer required.
